title: Trigger binding
description:
Binds an event to a flow. Bindings live with whoever owns the events; this schema exists so every dispatcher behaves identically.

The `condition` is evaluated in a sandbox FAIL-SAFE: false OR ERRORING cancels the handler run. An erroring condition must never read as true — that turns a typo into a flow that fires on everything.

event.description: Event name to match, e.g. `aokie.call.incoming`. Terminal flow events (`flow.succeeded` etc.) are bindable.

mode.description: `manual` never receives events — it renders a button. Binding a `manual` trigger to an event is an authoring mistake worth warning about.

condition.description: Sandboxed boolean expression over the event. Fail-safe: error means do not run.

inputMap.description: Maps event data onto flow inputs via selectors (`$event.data.callerPhone`). Resolved by the executor at run time — no caller expression is ever evaluated server-side.

outputActions.description: What to do with the result. Interpreted by the consuming product, not by OAIY.
